name: fable_session
description:
Fable Cognitive Engine Session & Telemetry Manager for MCP-compatible agent hosts.
Enforces immutable authority time-locks, evidence-gated epistemic tracking, formal invariant modeling, continuous rethink-refine cycles, phased progression, subagent delegation contract compilation, internal pacing telemetry, token compression subsystem (Content-Addressed Storage, 0.003 tokens/character invariant), and System 3 Meta-Cognitive Deliberation & Dialectical Evolutionary Architecture (Pearl do-calculus, TRIZ contradiction synthesis, 10D Pareto genetic search, axiom induction).

action.description: The Fable session action to perform.

accumulate_payload.description: Micro-payload text for adaptive batch accumulator or CAS storage.

antithesis_title.description: Title of the antithesis / adversarial critique for System 3 dialectical synthesis.

architectural_refinement.description: Concrete architectural evolution, optimization, or algorithm change derived from the critique.

artifact_path.description: Absolute filesystem path to blueprint artifact, proof, or benchmark script documenting the refinement.

cas_ref.description: CAS reference URI (cas://<sha256_hex>) or 64-char hash to retrieve, slice, or decompress.

claim.description: Fact, hypothesis statement, or unknown parameter to track in epistemic ledger.

content.description: Raw text content or payload to store/compress into Content-Addressed Storage (CAS).

contradiction_density.description: Contradiction density index [0.0, 1.0] for System 3 cognitive gear shifting.

contradictions.description: List of parameter trade-offs / contradictions to resolve with TRIZ principles.

critique_or_bottleneck.description: Critical flaw, vulnerability, edge case, memory/latency bottleneck, or assumption scrutinized.

crossover_rate.description: Genetic crossover rate probability for evolutionary engine (default 0.80).

edges.description: List of directed edge dictionaries for Causal DAG construction.

end_line.description: Ending line number (1-indexed inclusive) for windowed line slice viewing.

epistemic_uncertainty.description: Epistemic uncertainty index [0.0, 1.0] for System 3 arbitration.

evidence.description: Source file, command output, line number, or URL supporting the claim.

failure_count.description: Historical failure count for tri-level cognitive gear arbitration.

failure_modes.description: List of adversarial failure modes identified in critique.

focus_area.description: Specific subsystem, component, algorithm, or interface being critically re-evaluated.

force_flush.description: Force flush buffered micro-payloads immediately into a composite frame.

formal_statement.description: Mathematical or formal contract specification that must never be violated.

generations.description: Number of evolutionary generations to run (default 3).

include_line_numbers.description: Whether to format line slice with line numbers.

interventions.description: Dictionary of Pearl's do-operator interventions: {node_id: value}.

invariant_name.description: Identifier or title of the formal invariant (e.g., 'INV-01: Zero-Deadlock Ring Buffer').

label.description: Optional label or description for compressed CAS node.

max_debate_rounds.description: Maximum number of dialectical debate rounds for synthesis (default 4).

metadata.description: Optional metadata dictionary attached to accumulated micro-payload.

model_name.description: Name for the causal DAG model in System 3 simulation.

mutation_rate.description: Genetic mutation rate probability for evolutionary engine (default 0.15).

next_phase.description: Target phase to advance the session into.

nodes.description: List of node dictionaries for Causal DAG construction.

objective.description: High-level goal or problem statement for the reasoning session.

objective_weights.description: Optional dictionary of weights across the 10 Pareto dimensions.

payload.description: Micro-payload text for adaptive batch accumulator or CAS storage.

phase_summary.description: Concise summary of findings or deliverables completed in the previous phase.

population_size.description: Population size for evolutionary gene pool (default 12).

proof_or_rationale.description: Proof sketch, rationale, or inductive argument establishing the invariant.

rationale.description: Justification for unlocking code execution after satisfying cognitive gates.

seed_paradigms.description: Optional list of initial paradigm definitions to seed the gene pool.

session_name.description: Unique identifier / name for the Fable session.

start_line.description: Starting line number (1-indexed inclusive) for windowed line slice viewing.

subagent_prompt.description: The delegation prompt or contract text for the subagent to validate.

tag.description: Epistemic classification tag for truth calibration.

target_metric.description: Target KPI node ID for sensitivity and structural brittleness analysis.

target_residual_threshold.description: Target residual contradiction score threshold for convergence (default 0.15).

task_complexity.description: Task complexity index [0.0, 1.0] for tri-level cognitive arbitration.

terminal_probe_results.description: Live empirical probe output, benchmark figures, latency numbers, or profiling stats supporting the refinement.

thesis_description.description: Core architecture description and assumptions for the thesis candidate.

thesis_title.description: Title of the thesis paradigm for System 3 dialectical synthesis.

time_budget_minutes.description: Immutable outer authority budget in minutes; set_timer only changes internal pacing.
